== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Master Yoda (Errata)]] (PC-E1), Virtual Set 16, as the PC published it on 1 June 2022, taken unchanged from the PC's card-image repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif holotable commit e8445f0], file <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masteryoda.gif</code>; a PNG file served under a .gif name). Not a recreation.
